transcript.en: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

transcript.en: Hey Erika, how are you today?
transcript.zh: 嘿艾瑞卡，你今天怎么样？

transcript.en: Marco, I'm doing really well and I'm really looking forward to today's lesson.
transcript.zh: 马可，我很好，我真的很期待今天的课程。

transcript.en: Well so am I because here at EnglishPod we're giving you real English.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我也是，因为在 EnglishPod 我们给你地道的英语。

transcript.en: Exactly, English that you hear in movies or in TV shows.
transcript.zh: 没错，就是你在电影或电视节目中听到的英语。

transcript.en: This is English people actually use.
transcript.zh: 这是人们实际使用的英语。

transcript.en: So Erika, what is our topic for today?
transcript.zh: 那么艾瑞卡，我们今天的话题是什么？

transcript.en: Well today we're talking about computer viruses.
transcript.zh: 嗯，今天我们要聊电脑病毒。

transcript.en: Perfect, so I think it's time for us to take a look at our preview.
transcript.zh: 完美，那么我想该看看我们的预习词汇了。

transcript.en: Okay, today we've got two words to preview.
transcript.zh: 好的，今天有两个词要预习。

transcript.en: So, if your computer has a computer virus, it means your computer is sick, right?
transcript.zh: 那么，如果你的电脑有 computer virus，意味着你的电脑生病了，对吧？

transcript.en: Actually a computer virus is a program that is designed to harm or to damage your computer.
transcript.zh: 实际上，电脑病毒是一种被设计来损害或破坏你电脑的程序。

transcript.en: Well, thank you for being so technical.
transcript.zh: 嗯，谢谢你这么专业的解释。

transcript.en: Okay, let's take a look at our second word for our preview today and that would be froze.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们来看今天预习的第二个词，那就是 froze（死机/冻结）。

transcript.en: So, if your computer froze, it means that...
transcript.zh: 那么，如果你的电脑 froze，意思是……

transcript.en: Your applications or your programs stopped working and you just can't do anything.
transcript.zh: 你的应用程序或程序停止运行了，你什么也做不了。

transcript.en: So, let's listen to our dialogue.
It's going to be a little bit fast but...
Don't worry if you don't understand everything.
transcript.zh: 如果你不是全部听懂也不用担心。

transcript.en: At the end of this podcast, you'll understand everything.
transcript.zh: 在这期播客结束时，你会完全理解所有内容。

transcript.en: Oh great! This stupid computer froze again!
transcript.zh: 哦太棒了！这台破电脑又死机了！

transcript.en: Hey Samuel, can you come take a look at my PC?
transcript.zh: 嘿萨缪尔，你能过来帮我看看电脑吗？

transcript.en: It must have a virus or something.
Just give me a second. I'll be right up.
I ran a virus scan on your computer, and it turns out that you have a lot of infected files!
transcript.zh: 我在你电脑上跑了病毒扫描，结果发现你有很多被感染的文件！

transcript.en: But I'm quite careful when I'm browsing the internet,
transcript.zh: 但我上网的时候很小心啊，

transcript.en: I have no idea how I could have picked up a virus.
transcript.zh: 我真不知道怎么会中病毒的。

transcript.en: Well, you have to make sure that your anti-virus software is updated regularly.
transcript.zh: 嗯，你得确保你的杀毒软件定期更新。
你的软件没有更新到最新版，

transcript.en: that's probably what was causing your problems.
Yeah, try not to kick or hit the computer!
Well I completely understand this guy.
When my computer freezes, I kick it and punch it and do everything to it.
transcript.zh: 当我电脑死机的时候，我踢它、打它、对它做各种事。

transcript.en: I hope you don't punch it too hard, Marco.
transcript.zh: 我希望你别打得太用力，马可。

transcript.en: Well it's still working so it's alright.
Alright, let's take a look at our language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们来看看语言要点。

transcript.en: In today's language takeaway, we have two words.
transcript.zh: 今天的语言要点有两个词。

transcript.en: The first word for today is infected file.
transcript.zh: 第一个词是 infected file（被感染的文件）。

transcript.en: And what is an infected file?
An infected file is a file in your computer that has a virus in it.
transcript.zh: Infected file 就是你电脑里含有病毒的文件。

transcript.en: What is our second word for the language takeaway today?
transcript.zh: 我们今天语言要点的第二个词是什么？

transcript.en: Our second word is not up to date.
transcript.zh: 第二个词是 not up to date（不是最新的）。

transcript.en: And what is it when something is not up to date?
transcript.zh: 那么什么东西 not up to date 是什么意思？

transcript.en: It means it doesn't have all the most recent information.
transcript.zh: 意思是它没有包含所有最新的信息。

transcript.en: Now let's listen to some examples.
transcript.zh: 现在我们来听几个例子。

transcript.en: I need to buy a new computer because mine isn't up to date.
transcript.zh: 我需要买一台新电脑，因为我的那台不是最新的。

transcript.en: Are you sure this map is up to date?
transcript.zh: 你确定这张地图是最新的吗？

transcript.en: Sarah has just finished the reports and all the information is up to date.
transcript.zh: 莎拉刚完成了报告，所有信息都是最新的。

transcript.en: You know, you can also use this phrase positively.
transcript.zh: 你知道，你也可以用这个短语的肯定形式。

transcript.en: You can say up to date.
transcript.zh: 你可以说 up to date。

transcript.en: Okay, for example, we can say this is a new map.
transcript.zh: 好的，比如，我们可以说这是一张新地图。

transcript.en: This is the most up to date map.
Or if I bought a new computer, I could say I just got a new computer.
transcript.zh: 或者如果我买了一台新电脑，我可以说我刚买了一台新电脑。

transcript.en: All my software is up to date.
transcript.zh: 我的所有软件都是最新的。

transcript.en: So now let's take a look at some phrases.
transcript.zh: 那么现在我们来看一些短语。

transcript.en: And it's time for putting it all together.
Okay, so Samuel said a really great phrase.
transcript.zh: 好的，萨缪尔说了一个非常棒的短语。

transcript.en: He said, I'll be right up.
transcript.zh: 他说，I'll be right up（我马上上来）。

transcript.en: Now, we can use this phrase in a lot of different situations.
transcript.zh: 现在，我们可以在很多不同的场景中使用这个短语。

transcript.en: So let's listen to some examples.
transcript.zh: 那么我们来听几个例子。

transcript.en: Can you help me with my computer?
I need to use the bathroom.
Okay, really great and clear examples, right?
transcript.zh: 好的，非常棒和清晰的例子，对吧？

transcript.en: Yeah, you know that phrase, I'll be right out.
transcript.zh: 是啊，你知道那个短语 I'll be right out。

transcript.en: I used to hear this all the time when I was young.
transcript.zh: 我小时候经常听到这句话。

transcript.en: Well, I have two sisters and we were always fighting for the bathroom.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我有两个姐妹，我们总是抢洗手间。

transcript.en: So someone was always saying, just a minute, I'll be right out.
transcript.zh: 所以总有人在说，等一下，我马上出来。

transcript.en: I had that too when I was young.
Okay, now our second phrase is, it turns out that.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在我们的第二个短语是 it turns out that（结果发现）。

transcript.en: You can use it in many different situations.
transcript.zh: 你可以在很多不同的场景中使用它。

transcript.en: Marco, can you give us an example?
transcript.zh: 马可，你能给我们举个例子吗？

transcript.en: For example, I can say, Frank didn't come to work today and it turns out that he was sick.
transcript.zh: 比如，我可以说，弗兰克今天没来上班，结果发现他是生病了。

transcript.en: Or I could say, oh, I've been feeling really sick recently.
transcript.zh: 或者我可以说，哦，我最近一直觉得很不舒服。

transcript.en: It turns out that I'm pregnant.
So it's time for us to listen to our dialogue again, but this time it'll be a little bit slower.
transcript.zh: 那么现在该再听一遍我们的对话了，但这次会稍微慢一点。

transcript.en: Hey Samuel, can you come take a look at my PC?
transcript.zh: 嘿萨缪尔，你能过来帮我看看电脑吗？

transcript.en: It must have a virus or something.
I ran a virus scan on your computer, and it turns out that you have a lot of infected files!
transcript.zh: 我在你电脑上跑了病毒扫描，结果发现你有很多被感染的文件！

transcript.en: But I'm quite careful when I'm browsing the internet,
transcript.zh: 但我上网的时候很小心啊，

transcript.en: I have no idea how I could have picked up a virus.
transcript.zh: 我真不知道怎么会中病毒的。

transcript.en: Well, you have to make sure that your anti-virus software is updated regularly.
transcript.zh: 嗯，你得确保你的杀毒软件定期更新。
你的软件没有更新到最新版，

transcript.en: that's probably what was causing your problems.
Try not to kick or hit the computer!
That was a lot more clear this time.
So now it's time to look at Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 那么现在该看「流利表达」了。

transcript.en: Erika, why don't you explain what Fluency Builder is?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，你来解释一下什么是流利表达？

transcript.en: In Fluency Builder, we give you some great useful phrases to help you express your ideas clearly.
transcript.zh: 在流利表达环节，我们给你一些很棒、很实用的短语，帮助你清晰表达你的想法。

transcript.en: So let's look at Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 那我们来看看流利表达。

transcript.en: So in this dialogue, we know his computer wasn't working.
transcript.zh: 在这段对话中，我们知道他的电脑不工作了。

transcript.en: So many students would probably say his computer was acting strangely.
transcript.zh: 所以很多学生可能会说他的电脑表现异常。

transcript.en: And that's perfect and that's fine.
transcript.zh: 那样说完全没问题。挺好。

transcript.en: But there's a really great way to say it that we heard in the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 但我们在对话中听到了一种非常好的表达方式。
It's acting up again（它又出毛病了）。
It's acting up again（它又出毛病了）。
它听起来就是非常自然。

transcript.en: We're going to listen to our dialogue a third time, but this time it'll be at the normal speed.
transcript.zh: 我们要听第三遍对话了，但这次是正常语速。

transcript.en: Try and see if you can hear these key words.
transcript.zh: 试试看你能不能听到这些关键词。

transcript.en: Can you come take a look at my PC?
transcript.zh: 你能过来帮我看看电脑吗？

transcript.en: It must have a virus or something.
I ran a virus scan on your computer, and it turns out that you have a lot of infected files!
transcript.zh: 我在你电脑上跑了病毒扫描，结果发现你有很多被感染的文件！

transcript.en: But I'm quite careful when I'm browsing the internet,
transcript.zh: 但我上网的时候很小心啊，

transcript.en: I have no idea how I could have picked up a virus.
transcript.zh: 我真不知道怎么会中病毒的。

transcript.en: Well, you have to make sure that your anti-virus software is updated regularly.
transcript.zh: 嗯，你得确保你的杀毒软件定期更新。
你的软件没有更新到最新版，

transcript.en: that's probably what was causing your problems.
Try not to kick or hit the computer!
So Marco, I really think that my computer actually has a virus now.
transcript.zh: 那么马可，我真的觉得我的电脑现在确实中病毒了。

transcript.en: I've been turning on my computer and then suddenly it turns off by itself.
transcript.zh: 我开机后，它突然自己关机了。

transcript.en: But I ran a virus scan and there was no problem.
transcript.zh: 但我跑了病毒扫描，没有问题啊。

transcript.en: Well, maybe your antivirus software isn't up to date.
transcript.zh: 嗯，也许你的杀毒软件不是最新的。

transcript.en: I guess I'd better call Samuel.
transcript.zh: 我想我最好叫萨缪尔来。

transcript.en: You can call Samuel to fix it.
We're out of time now, but be sure to go to our website at EnglishPod.com where you can leave all your questions and comments.
transcript.zh: 我们时间到了，但一定要去我们的网站 EnglishPod.com，在那里你可以留下所有的问题和评论。

transcript.en: So stay tuned for our next great lesson.
transcript.zh: 那么请继续关注我们的下一节精彩课程。
